title: Twisted Love
author: Ana Huang
summary: A young woman is thrown into close contact with her brother’s intimidating friend, a controlled and wealthy man who says he does not do relationships. As they spend time together, the attraction wins out.
readIf: you like billionaire-style contemporary romance with a cold hero and a lot of heat.
skipIf: you dislike possessive male leads or want a low-spice, character-driven romance.

pairings.reason: Another contemporary romance built on two people who spend time together and cross a line.
A rom-com with more humour in the dynamic between a hero and a heroine from different worlds.
A more famous billionaire romance with a similar blend of power imbalance and passion.
